item.title: Residents Pack Duluth City Hall Surrounding ICE
item.description: DULUTH, Minn– Duluth Residents gathered and packed City Hall. Many people at Monday night’s city counsel meeting expressed disapproval of ICE’s presence in the the Northland and Twin Cities.
